title.narrative: Strengthened institutional capacity of workers' organizations

description.narrative: General Federation of Oman Workers GFOW has an important role in representing workers in Oman and strengthening services for migrant workers, including domestic workers. ILO will support GFOW through a package of capacity-building, evidence generation, outreach and institutional cooperation activities linked to migrant-inclusive social protection. The intervention will strengthen GFOW’s knowledge of social protection principles, international labour standards and Oman’s Social Protection Law reforms, while generating evidence on migrant workers’ awareness, experiences and barriers in accessing benefits. It will also support structured cooperation between GFOW and the Social Protection Fund, including improved information provision and responsiveness to migrant workers’ queries. In parallel, ILO will support GFOW to organize and educate migrant workers in priority sectors, including domestic work, through training-of-trainers, outreach activities, multilingual information and the development of a targeted organizing strategy.
